Problem Statement:
Raju is in horror land, which is 13-dimensional. The dice in horror land have 13 faces. When a die is thrown there are 13 possible outcomes from 1 to 13. N dice are thrown simultaneously. Find the number of possible outcomes.
input_spec: The only line of input contains an integer N.
output_spec: Print a line, the number of possible outcomes. Since the answer can be very large, print it modulo 1,000,000,007
